text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.armou: The number of decimal places displayed.
Switch between displaying the durability as a percentage, fraction or number (fraction without the denominator).
Display the durability bar of the item.
text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.encha: Makes enchantments at their maximum level bold in item tooltips.
Lists the enchantments already on the item.
Shows the maximum level after enchantments below it.
Lists the enchantments the item could still get.
Shows a "Missing:" line above the missing enchantments.
text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.entit: Show non-hostile land mobs (animals) in the list of loaded entities.
Show hostile mobs (monsters) in the list of loaded entities.
Everything that is not a mob: players, items, projectiles, armour stands, vehicles and so on.
Fish, squid, dolphins, axolotls and other water mobs.
text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.foodH: When the items are spread over several slots, also list the count in each slot (hotbar left to right, then the inventory rows, then the off hand).
text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.motio: The number of decimal places displayed.
Also show the speed in blocks per tick.
text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.netwo: Colour ping and TPS from dark green (good) to dark red (bad).
How many of the server's game time reports (sent about once a second) the TPS is averaged over.
text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.perfo: How long the GPU takes to draw each frame, in milliseconds.
The share of each frame's time that the GPU spends drawing it.
text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.posit: Shows how many of the 16x16x16 chunk sections around the player are rendered, out of all of them, as on the F3 debug screen.
Shows how many entities are rendered, out of all loaded ones, as on the F3 debug screen.
The number of decimal places displayed.
The number of decimal places displayed.
Only show the rotation numbers while you hold an axe, a hoe or a Hypixel SkyBlock farming tool.
Show the biome at the player's position.
Show the player's block position within the current 16x16x16 chunk section.
Show the direction that the player is facing.
Show sky and block light at the player's feet.
When your yaw has wound past ±180°, also show the raw value the game stores.
text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.proje: When the items are spread over several slots, also list the count in each slot (hotbar left to right, then the inventory rows, then the off hand).
text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.quali: Overrides the dimension's ambient light. Set to 0 to disable.
text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.reach: The number of decimal places displayed.
Refresh only when attack changes from released to pressed.
text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.toggl: Also show the game's toggle setting and the key's state for sprint and sneak, for debugging.
text.autoconfig.brainagehud.option.waypo: Shows every waypoint's name. Otherwise only the waypoint you look towards and waypoints nearby show their names; the rest show just their distance.
A beam through the whole height of the world, visible from far away.
Draws the current dimension's visible waypoints in the world.
The name and distance above the waypoint, readable through walls.
A floating, spinning gem above the waypoint, with a pulse on the ground below it when near.
A built-in waypoint at 0, 63, 0 in every dimension.
